bagPolicy.summary: You can bring a small personal item such as a purse. Backpacks and larger bags aren't allowed.
allowed: Small personal items such as a purse
bagPolicy.quote: Patrons are allowed to attend with a small personal item such as a purse. Backpacks and larger bags are NOT ALLOWED.

parking.summary: Street parking is free after 7 pm throughout The Hill. The City of Boulder's website has an interactive parking map that includes accessible options.
parking.quote: Street parking (free after 7pm) is provided throughout The Hill.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Fox Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drink aren't allowed. You can bring an empty water bottle without its lid, but sealed water bottles are not permitted.
allowed: Empty water bottle without the lid
concessions.quote: Outside food and drink are not allowed.

accessibility.summary: For reserved seated shows, buy the designated accessible tickets online, or contact boxoffice@z2ent.com or 303.786.7030 if none are available. For general admission shows, buy your GA tickets first, then contact the box office about seating.
accessibility.quote: If you wish to attend a reserved seated show, please look for our designated accessible tickets when purchasing online.

reEntry.summary: Fox Theatre hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Monday through Friday, 10 am to 4 pm, and on event nights it opens one hour before doors. Call 720.645.2467 or text 303.786.7030 with questions.
ticketPickup.quote: On event nights, 1 hour before doors open.

gates.summary: Fox Theatre hasn't published door and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
